THE STORY BEHIND THE STORIES

Curiosity became a craft.
Purpose made it a business.

I began with a $10 camera phone, photographing the world along my daily route. I kept learning, kept creating, and eventually paid for a better phone through photography and video work.

That beginning still shapes how I work. I care about the people in front of the camera, the details around them, and the story they want to share.

When I met my wife Kimberly, her nonprofit, Nu Vizion Foundation 4 Lyfe, needed a way for people to see its work. Creating that platform strengthened something I already believed: small businesses, nonprofits, and communities deserve thoughtful visual representation.

JHG Productions brings that belief into films, photographs, interviews, promotional content, animation, and immersive environments. The tools keep changing. The purpose stays personal.

John H. GuessFOUNDER · JHG PRODUCTIONS LLC
